shared_elements: low-relief / linear engraved motifs on stone
circular disc motif (A) vs. cup-like/round signs (B)
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic engraved motifs including simplified human-like figures and round signs, but that is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A is a single monumental anthropomorphic figure with relief motifs (a disc, arcs, a face-like head) organised around a body, whereas B is a scattered field of linear boat images with crews, striding stick-figures and small cup marks, sharing no specific motif, relationship or layout with A.
